title: List
description: Split a list in a single column to multiple columns.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the column to be split.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of column(s) for the results. If providing a single column, use a wildcard (*) to indicate a incrementing integer.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Split a list into multiple columns. If only one output is given, `split.list` returns the same list it was given, so output should be a list of columns or a column name with a wildcard (`*`). ## Migrated examples #### Using a Wildcard ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - split.list: input: Column output: Column* ```
##### Input Sample | Column | | --- | | ['A', 'B', 'C'] |
##### Output Sample | Column1 | Column2 | Column3 | | --- | --- | --- | | A | B | C |
#### Named Columns ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - split.list: input: Column output: - Heading A - Heading B - Heading C ```
##### Input Sample | Column | | --- | | ['A', 'B', 'C'] |
##### Output Sample | Heading A | Heading B | Heading C | | --- | --- | --- | | A | B | C |
